reviews.review_title: Had more fun here than any other revival
reviews.review_description:
RecPlace, even in its unfinished state, is already bringing back all the fun I had back in 2023. The community is honestly better than every other revival I've seen out there, most revivals have a very toxic, mean, and all around disrespectful community of people. RecPlace on the other hand has a very nice, welcoming community where anyone can have fun by socializing with others. The moderation is also really good, the mods don't abuse their power against people, they make sure people follow the rules and they do this job very well. The developers are constantly working on more features that make developing games and importing old games easier, and not only that, bit they also have really good communication, when an update is coming, they let you know, they take feedback from the community unlike Rec Room, and they try their best to make people happy. This will most definitely be the best 2023 build you can play when the full release comes out.

Thank you for your time, @axrecplace on tt and yt
